_comment: R58.2 (2026-09-03): Phase 1.3 hardware preset for RTX 30xx 8GB VRAM (RTX 3050/3060/3070/3080 8GB). Aggressive RAM fallback — most large models (>8GB) won't fit VRAM and will use partial offload or CPU-only.

_model_recommendations._comment: Models that comfortably fit at 8GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quant):
_model_recommendations._recommendation: Use Q4_K_M or lower for anything >7B parameters. Q5/Q6/Q8 will OOM.

cppworker._kv_cache_note: Q4 KV cache is critical at 8GB — F16 KV would push small models OOM

ram_fallback._comment: 3-tier cascade: full VRAM → partial offload → CPU-only. Aggressive at 8GB since most models won't fit.
ram_fallback._max_n_ctx_note: Lowered to 64K (vs 128K default) — large contexts blow up KV cache

balancer._comment: Balancer tuning for 8GB target. First-byte timeout shorter than default because 30B+ models will take 10+ min to prefill.
